title: Fabulous Breathtaking Beachfront Sunsets Everyday
description: Unwind in our spacious villa boasting cozy balconies with sweeping views of the western beaches and eastern mountains. Gather with loved ones in the open-plan living and dining areas, cook memorable meals in the fully equipped kitchen, and relax to the sound of the waves. Whether you’re planning seaside adventures or simply soaking in the sunset, our home away from home offers the perfect setting for relaxation and rejuvenation.The spaceAs you enter the gate, a sense of homeliness welcomes you to this family-oriented abode. The charming beachfront villa features four private bedrooms: three on the ground floor and a master suite upstairs with a king-sized bed, bath, beach-view balcony, and a terrace overlooking the mountains. The open floor plan on the ground level invites guests to mingle during meal prep, dine together at the spacious table, or enjoy the latest movie on TV. The kitchen, dining, and living areas offer panoramic views of the tranquil beach, perfect for planning your daily seaside activities or enjoying a relaxed breakfast on the living room balcony.One of the ground floor bedrooms has a king-sized bed and a private balcony with seating. Down the hall, you'll find two bathrooms with showers and two additional private bedrooms—one with two twin-sized bunk beds accommodating four, and another with a queen-sized bed for two. These rooms share the two bathrooms. The master bedroom upstairs boasts a king-sized bed and an en-suite bathroom with a combined tub and shower. For your comfort, all bedrooms come with ceiling fans and air conditioning units, though you're invited to open the windows and savor the evening ocean breeze (kindly turn off the AC).The galley-style kitchen is fully equipped with an electric stove, microwave, and a refrigerator featuring an ice/water dispenser. It's filled with cookware, utensils, dishware, and glassware. Linens and towels are provided (washcloths are excluded due to frequent theft), and you have access to a washer and dryer for convenience.Located just a short walk from the shore, this bi-level villa is perched on the third floor, affording magnificent views of the serene beachfront and the eastern mountain range.Guest accessGuests have full access to the entire villa, including all bedrooms, balconies with beach and mountain views, the living and dining areas, and the fully equipped kitchen. Please note that the villa is located on the third floor and is accessible by stairs only; there is no elevator available.Other things to notePets are strictly prohibited anywhere on the property. Smoking is not permitted indoors or anywhere on the premises. Please keep noise levels down, enjoy meals at the dining table, dispose of trash in the bins provided and conserve energy by keeping the AC on only when windows and doors are closed. Return any provided keys or fobs at checkout and scramble the door code. Thank you for treating our home with care.

description: Welcome to one of the biggest private rooftop decks in PR with stunning ocean views! Perfect for family reunions, large parties, or any venues (rooftop wedding?)! This brand new property sleeps 24 people, in four separate villas! We’ve spared no expense to make every inch of this property an amazing spot to relax or socialize with family and friends. La Casa Greub is also only 2-3 minutes walk from the beach, and within walking distance of amazing restaurants and bars!See you soon!The space2 Minute Walk To The Beach | Newly Renovated | 10 Bedrooms | 24 Guests | 4 Kitchens (Stove and Microwave) | 5 outdoor dining areas | Rooftop Deck (The Tree House) | 4 outdoor lounging areas | 5.5 bathrooms |You will have private access to the entire property at La Casa Greub in Stella Rincón, PR. This villa has a rooftop deck (partially covered) that has a beautiful view of the ocean, mountains, and local vegetation. There is also a lounge area on the second floor with a great vibe and multiple places to hang out and relax. This villa is within an easy 2 minute walk to the beach.This villa can accommodate up to 24 guests in 4 different units. - Villa 1 - A three bedroom apartment with two rooms that have a queen sized mattress and a room with a two twin sized bunk-bed ( 6 beds total).- Villa 2 - A two bedroom apartment with one room that has a queen sized mattress and one room with a bunk-bed that has a twin sized mattresses over a full mattress (3 beds total). - Villa 3 - A three bedroom apartment with two rooms that have a queen sized mattress and a room that has two twin sized bunk-beds (6 beds total).- Villa 4 - A two bedroom apartment with a room that has a queen sized mattress and a room with a twin sized mattress over a full mattress bunk-bed (3 beds total).Each room of this villa has its own air conditioning, heating, ceiling fan, clothing storage, and lamp. There is also a spacious open living/kitchen area with a large sectional and TV in each unit. Each unit also has a complete bathroom with a walk-in shower.Guest accessYou will have private access to the entire property of La Casa Greub. This includes the 4 different units, rooftop, second floor lounge, and first floor deck. There is also plenty of parking on both sides of the property. All guests of La Casa Greub have access to the first-floor deck, second-floor lounge and the rooftop deck. Be sure to visit the beautiful rooftop created for socializing, relaxing, and enjoying the beautiful view of the ocean and mountains. The rooftop has two twin sized swings, picnic table, BBQ Grill, refrigerator, sink, bathroom, outdoor furniture, and lounge chairs. There is also an outdoor shower located on the ground level to wash off after visiting the beach.There is two different beaches located within a 2 minute walk of the property, no need to drive there.Other things to noteEach unit is accommodated with shampoo, conditioner, body wash, coffee maker, blender, dishes, utensils, soap, and ice trays. We have pots and pans in each Villa but no oil, salt, or pepper.You will have access to a washer and dryer located on the second floor, which is also shared with other guests. We also have a Pack’n Play crib available upon request.

title: Casa Vista Rosa Miracles
description: This exceptional home in a picturesque mountain area offers breathtaking views of the Rincon/Aguada Coast. Enjoy tranquility and serenity with a private pool, convenient parking, and all necessary amenities for an unforgettable vacation in Rincon, Puerto Rico. Just a 6-minute drive to the town center, you'll have easy access to pristine beaches and a variety of restaurants and bars. Experience the perfect blend of relaxation and adventure in this idyllic retreat.The spaceLooking for a spacious and versatile home for your next family vacation? Look no further than this stunning property! With 4 generously sized bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, there's plenty of room for everyone to relax and unwind. Plus, with a full kitchen and a convenient kitchenette, you'll have all the space and amenities you need to prepare delicious meals and snacks throughout your stay. And if you're traveling with multiple families, you'll love the flexibility of this home's two separate units, each with its own entrance. Whether you're looking for a cozy retreat or a spacious gathering place, this home has it all - including a private pool and parking for your convenience. Book your stay today and experience the ultimate in comfort and convenience!Other things to noteHome also comes equipped with an electric generator and water reservoir, which is an incredible advantage considering Puerto Rico's frequent power and water outages.

title: La Vista Suite | Private Rooftop Sunset Retreat
description: La Vista Suite- A boutique retreat steps from Rincon’s most secluded beach. Recently refreshed with luxurious bedding, high-speed Wi-Fi, and a renewed attention to guest comfort, this romantic suite features a memory foam bed with luxurious linens, kitchenette, cozy living area, ocean-facing coffee deck, and a private rooftop retreat with soaking tub, rainfall shower, firepit table and breathtaking sunset ocean views. Guests enjoy access to the pool, BBQ area, and complimentary beach essentials.The spaceTucked within one of Rincon’s oldest and quietest beachside neighborhoods, La Piña Boutique Hotel offers a peaceful boutique escape centered around relaxation, authenticity, and coastal living. With only seven suites and a maximum of 16 guests on property, the atmosphere remains calm, intimate, and uncrowded — a refreshing alternative to larger resorts.Located less than 100 feet from one of Rincon’s most secluded hidden beaches, guests can enjoy swimming, snorkeling, sunset walks, and quiet beach days just steps from their suite. A relaxed beachfront bar sits directly on the shoreline, offering sunset views, ocean breezes, live local conversation, and one of the area’s most authentic hidden gems.Despite the peaceful setting, the hotel remains centrally located to everything Rincon has to offer — including beaches, restaurants, coffee shops, nightlife, surf spots, and the historic town plaza. Guests can explore the famous Thursday night Art Walk in the Pueblo featuring local artisans, handmade goods, live music, outdoor dining, and dancing throughout the town square. Sunday mornings also bring Rincon’s beloved local farmers market filled with fresh produce, crafts, and island flavors.Guests also enjoy access to the hotel’s swimming pool, rooftop sunset deck with fire pits, outdoor BBQ patio, and complimentary beach essentials including chairs, umbrellas, towels, and coolers for effortless beach days.For those seeking adventure or relaxation, nearby rentals and experiences include snorkeling, bicycles, dive lessons, beach massages, and guided local excursions — all conveniently close to the hotel.Guest accessDuring your stay, you will have access to all the amenities at La Piña, including a swimming pool, outdoor patio with loungers and umbrellas, an outdoor kitchen and BBQ, and our favorite feature, the rooftop sunset deck with fire pits. Or grab our complimentary beach chairs, towels, and umbrella, and head to the sand! (Blue and White striped towels are for pool and beach use. Please leave grey towels in your room) Your room includes a complete kitchenette with a microwave, refrigerator, coffee maker (FRESH local Puerto Rican coffee included), electric hot plate, and all necessary pots, pans, plates, and utensils. The laundry room is free to use, and laundry soap is included. In addition, all rooms come with shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and hand soap.Other things to noteBlue and white towels are for pool and beach use. Please leave grey towels in the room for showering and bathing. Please use the foot wash by the front entrance or one of the two outdoor public showers to rinse off the sand before getting in the pool. All kitchens are equipped with cleaning supplies under the sink and a fire extinguisher. First aid kits are located under the bathroom sink and a large first aid kit is located in the laundry mounted on the wall by the door.
